_readme: Companies whose career pages should be checked directly. These are the highest-signal postings — no aggregator delay. Add entries as you find companies worth watching. Each needs: ats (greenhouse | lever | ashby), token, and an optional display name. Find the token in the company's careers URL, e.g. job-boards.greenhouse.io/ACMECORP → { "ats": "greenhouse", "token": "acmecorp" }. Marketing agencies, email service providers (Klaviyo, Braze, Iterable…), retail/e-commerce brands with in-house email teams, and Michigan employers (Stryker, Kellanova, Perrigo, Whirlpool, WMU) are all good candidates.
